limitations: Hand-authored synthetic engineering examples. This is a regression benchmark, not evidence of real-user hiring impact. The heldout partition must not be used to tune retrieval thresholds.

documents.text: Implemented a Python FastAPI service with PostgreSQL and SQL persistence. Validated order requests and wrote database integration tests.
Built a source-grounded RAG retrieval pipeline with pgvector embeddings and lexical search. Evaluated relevance against labeled queries and attached citations.
Added Redis caching with expiry, invalidation and cache-miss handling for frequently requested API responses.
Implemented a durable background queue with retry limits, worker leases, cancellation and idempotent message processing.
Implemented OAuth and JWT authentication with user ownership checks and tenant isolation. Tested that users cannot read another user's records.
Built accessible React and TypeScript forms with keyboard navigation, visible focus, validation errors and responsive mobile layouts.
Wrote pytest integration tests for database migrations and API contracts. Exercised rollback and regression cases.
Packaged a web service with Docker and configured CI deployment health checks and database restore exercises.
Implemented a Go command-line parser with error handling and unit tests for invalid arguments.
Implemented a C# service and a C++ library with explicit memory ownership and resource cleanup.
README keywords only: FastAPI PostgreSQL Redis RAG pgvector Docker Kubernetes Kafka Terraform. These are roadmap wishes, not implemented work. This is a fork and authorship is unconfirmed.
A recipe collection describing sourdough bread, flour, water and fermentation. No software work is described.
